project.title: Why AI Needs So Much Electricity
project.question: Why is AI infrastructure increasing electricity demand?

facts.statement: Data-centre electricity demand is expected to grow materially as AI workloads expand.

claims.statement: The AI boom is also a physical infrastructure and electricity story.

scenes.title: The invisible factory
scenes.narration: Every AI answer begins in a physical place filled with chips, cooling systems and electrical equipment.

scenes.title: Where the power goes
scenes.narration: Computing and cooling turn electricity into usable AI capacity, while grid connections limit how quickly new sites can open.

scenes.title: The real bottleneck
scenes.narration: The next AI breakthrough may depend as much on transformers and transmission lines as on faster algorithms.

narrationSegments.text: Every AI answer begins in a physical place. Behind the interface are processors, cooling equipment and power supplies. The intelligence may feel weightless, but the infrastructure is not. Specialized chips move data and release heat. Cooling systems turn more electricity into reliable computing capacity. A new data centre also needs a connection to the grid. Transformers, transmission and generation can become the constraint. Faster chips still need substations and dependable power. The AI race is becoming an infrastructure race.
